children: Granite Ridge Resources’ third-quarter revenue rose 57% year over year, while earnings shifted to a loss from income. Higher oil production and realized prices, along with stronger natural gas prices, lifted sales; losses on commodity derivatives, higher operating costs and interest expense weighed on results.
¹ Reported as “Oil and natural gas sales”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Average daily production increased to 34,641 Boe from 31,925 Boe, driven by drilling success and acquired net revenue interests.
: Revenue rose 60%, with production up 17% and realized prices excluding settled derivatives up 37%.
: Revenue increased 45%, driven by a 45% increase in realized prices excluding settled derivatives.
: Commodity derivatives recorded a $52.7M loss, including a $31.8M unrealized loss.
